scope.summary: Gate Tailor interlink work on the validated PoseKit merge, then implement the canonical revisioned binding and shared schema/hash/store foundation for Atelier character/sheet refs and BodyKit body/avatar ids.
acceptance_criteria: Before any Atelier implementation or fixture is read, the source commit a2abba07af8e0446d5cd988f5aaabc1c7f48cbfe must have a non-NONE merged_main_commit, main containment CONTAINED/PASS, and current-main compatibility PASS against the pinned main/WP-KERNEL-012 baseline.

The containment receipt records validator INTEGRATION_VALIDATOR-20260708-ckc-v2, validated source SHA, merge SHA, baseline SHA, and merged-main schema-fixture compatibility; dirty or unmerged PoseKit worktree files are forbidden implementation inputs.

Registers hsk.tailor.character_body_binding@1 and the interlink schema registry. Canonical bytes use crate::llm::canonical_json_bytes_nfc and hashes use sha256:<64hex> over schema id/version, revision, semantic fields, and source hashes while excluding storage-location refs, storage-local surrogate row ids, timestamps, and receipts while including semantic typed character, sheet-version, body, avatar, actor, entity, and source refs.

Unknown major schema versions fail closed; accepted older versions require explicit deterministic migration before hashing or use. Pinned sheet-version refs never silently advance, while explicit follow-head marks every derived proposal stale on head change.

atelier://character stable refs, immutable sheet-version refs, BodyKit body/avatar ids, actors, leases, events, and receipts remain distinct and are verified before binding; wrong-character, stale-base, lease, cancellation, replay, and orphan recovery paths are covered.

The shared interlink store indexes immutable ArtifactStore refs and their EventLedger events and supplies transactional idempotency, list/get, replay, outbox, and orphan-recovery state for MT-711..717 records; payload bytes remain content-addressed and hash-verified.
scope.risk_if_missed: Reading merge-withheld or dirty PoseKit state, conflating UUID spaces, or hashing storage metadata could bind and replay derived body/pose state against the wrong character.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior is observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; the owning native-shell MT verifies GUI projection.

target_entries: Tailor model manual > Interlink containment and schema law

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
